title: Name and place the cloned-state fixture-root witness according to its ownership scope
outcome: The fixture-root lifetime witness is discoverable with the shared boot-helper tests and its name and owning module header describe the property it tests.
acceptance: Rename a_persisted_queued_prompt_state_keeps_its_root_until_the_last_continuation to describe retention of the fixture root by a cloned AppState, and either move it beside shared boot-helper tests or document that ownership explicitly in its module header.
Keep its deterministic channel barrier, real writer shutdown, late synchronous write, joined continuation, early-cleanup/root-survival checks and final cleanup receipt/root/marker checks unchanged.
